basic_information.recipe_name: Standard Exhaust Dyeing of Cotton Knits with Bifunctional Reactive Dyes

dye_information.dye_name: Reactive Blue 19 (1.2% owf) + Reactive Red 195 (0.5% owf) + Reactive Yellow 145 (0.3% owf)

chemical_information.chemical_function: Electrolyte to drive dye exhaustion onto fiber surface
chemical_information.addition_sequence: Added in 2 equal splits at 40°C prior to alkali dosing
chemical_information.compatibility: Compatible with non-ionic and anionic wetting agents
chemical_information.incompatible_chemicals: Cationic fixing agents, strong concentrated acids

chemical_information.chemical_function: Alkali buffer to generate cellulosate ions for covalent dye fixation
chemical_information.addition_sequence: Dosed exponentially over 30 min after 20 min salt exhaustion hold
chemical_information.compatibility: Compatible with standard reactive dye auxiliaries

process_parameters.temperature_profile: Start 40°C -> Heat to 60°C @ 1.5°C/min -> Hold 60 min -> Cool to 50°C @ 2.0°C/min -> Soap @ 95°C
process_parameters.ph: Exhaustion pH: 6.8 - 7.2 | Fixation pH: 10.8 - 11.2 | Neutralized pH: 6.0 - 6.5

process_steps.pretreatment: Scoured & bleached cotton; core pH 6.5; residual H2O2 < 5 ppm
process_steps.dye_addition: Dissolve dyes in warm water (50°C), strain through mesh, dose over 10 min at 40°C
process_steps.salt_addition: Dose Glauber's salt (45 g/L) in two portions (50% at 40°C, 50% at 60°C)
process_steps.alkali_addition: Dose Soda Ash (15 g/L) exponentially over 30 min once 60°C is reached
process_steps.washing: Drain fixation bath -> Cold rinse (10 min) -> Hot rinse at 70°C (10 min)
process_steps.soaping: Neutralize with Acetic Acid (1.0 g/L) -> Soap with Polymeric Agent at 95°C for 15 min
process_steps.neutralization: Final rinse with Acetic Acid (0.5 g/L) to bring core fabric pH to 6.0 - 6.5
process_steps.drying: Relaxation dryer or Stenter frame at 120°C to target 6% moisture
process_steps.finishing: Apply 1.5% Bio-softener via padding or exhaust at 40°C

machine_requirement.recommended_machine: Fong's / Thies Soft-Flow Jet Dyeing Vessel

quality_parameters.rub_fastness: Dry Rubbing: Grade 4-5 | Wet Rubbing: Grade 3-4

defects.common_defects: Patchiness / Unlevelness, Crease Marks, Low Wet Fastness
defects.causes: Rapid alkali addition, turn time > 120 s, incomplete removal of hydrolyzed dye
defects.corrective_actions: Leveling agent strip & redye; optimize exponential alkali dosing; ensure soaping at 95°C

safety.ppe_required: Chemical splash goggles, neoprene gloves, rubber apron, dust mask during dye powder weighing
safety.safety_precautions: Operate eye wash station nearby; store acids and alkalis in separate bunded areas

references.source: SDC / AATCC Standard Reactive Dyeing Guidelines
references.notes: Ensure total dissolved solids (TDS) of input water < 250 ppm and hardness < 10 ppm

basic_information.recipe_name: HTHP Exhaust Dyeing of 100% Polyester Woven Fabric with Disperse Dyes

dye_information.dye_type: High-Thermal Fastness Disperse Dye (SE / HW Type)
dye_information.dye_name: Disperse Blue 79 (2.8% owf) + Disperse Navy 56 (1.0% owf) + Disperse Rubine 56 (0.2% owf)

chemical_information.chemical_function: Keeps non-ionic disperse dye particles suspended in water at 130°C
chemical_information.addition_sequence: Added to dye bath at 50°C before dye dispersion addition
chemical_information.compatibility: Compatible with non-ionic and anionic leveling agents

chemical_information.chemical_function: Maintains acidic bath pH to prevent disperse dye reduction
chemical_information.dosage: 1.0 g/L Acetic Acid + 0.5 g/L Sodium Acetate
chemical_information.addition_sequence: Dosed during bath setup to establish target pH 4.5 - 5.0
chemical_information.compatibility: Compatible with all disperse dye auxiliaries

process_parameters.temperature_profile: Start 60°C -> Heat to 90°C @ 2.0°C/min -> Heat to 130°C @ 1.0°C/min -> Hold 130°C for 45 min -> Cool to 80°C @ 1.5°C/min
process_parameters.heating_rate: 1.0 °C/min through critical plasticization strike zone (90°C to 130°C)

process_steps.pretreatment: Preshrunk and heat-set woven polyester; free of silicone knitting oils
process_steps.dye_addition: Disperse dyes pasted with warm water (50°C), high-shear mixed, filtered into tank
process_steps.salt_addition: N/A (Electrolytes not used in disperse dyeing)
process_steps.alkali_addition: N/A during dyeing bath; Caustic Soda added during Reduction Clearing
process_steps.washing: Drain 130°C bath at 80°C -> Hot rinse at 70°C
process_steps.soaping: Reduction Clearing: 2.5 g/L Hydros + 2.0 g/L NaOH + 1 g/L detergent at 80°C for 20 min
process_steps.neutralization: Drain RC bath -> Rinse -> Neutralize with 1.0 g/L Acetic Acid at 50°C for 10 min
process_steps.drying: Stenter frame drying and final heat-setting at 170°C for 30 seconds

machine_requirement.recommended_machine: Thies iMaster HTHP Jet Dyeing Vessel

quality_parameters.rub_fastness: Dry Rubbing: Grade 4-5 | Wet Rubbing: Grade 4
quality_parameters.uniformity: Completely streak-free and oligomer-free fabric surface

defects.common_defects: Oligomer White Powder Spotting, Color Specks, Thermal Translocation Unlevelness
defects.causes: Rapid cooling below 100°C, dye agglomeration, unstable pH > 5.5 during dyeing
defects.corrective_actions: Hot drain at 80°C; add high-temp dispersing agent; maintain pH strictly at 4.5

safety.ppe_required: Heat-resistant safety gloves, full face shield, protective chemical suit during sampling
safety.hazardous_chemicals: Sodium Hydrosulfite (spontaneously combustible when damp), Caustic Soda (corrosive)
safety.safety_precautions: Ensure vessel pressure gauge reads 0.0 bar before unlocking pneumatic door safety pin

references.source: Industrial Polyester HTHP Wet Processing Standards
references.notes: Monitor differential pressure across filter mesh to prevent dye aggregation

basic_information.recipe_name: Acid Dyeing of Nylon 6,6 Microfiber Knits

dye_information.dye_type: Half-milling Acid Dye / 1:2 Metal Complex Dye
dye_information.dye_name: Acid Red 138 (2.0% owf) + Acid Orange 67 (0.5% owf)

chemical_information.chemical_function: Slow acid releaser; gradually lowers bath pH during heating to control strike rate
chemical_information.addition_sequence: Added at start of bath filling at 40°C

chemical_information.chemical_function: Competes for amine end-groups on Nylon to prevent streaky barre defects
chemical_information.addition_sequence: Dosed 10 min prior to dye addition at 40°C

chemical_information.chemical_function: Crosslinks dye molecules inside polyamide matrix to boost wash fastness
chemical_information.addition_sequence: Applied in a fresh post-treatment bath at 70°C for 20 min at pH 4.5

process_parameters.temperature_profile: Start 40°C -> Heat to 98°C @ 1.0°C/min -> Hold 98°C for 45 min -> Cool to 70°C @ 1.5°C/min -> Syntan Fix @ 70°C
process_parameters.heating_rate: 1.0 °C/min (controlled rate above 70°C where dye uptake accelerates)
process_parameters.ph: Dyeing pH: 4.8 - 5.2 (Ammonium Sulfate) | Fixing pH: 4.5 (Acetic Acid)

process_steps.pretreatment: Scoured at 70°C with non-ionic detergent; heat-set at 185°C to stabilize Spandex width
process_steps.dye_addition: Dissolve Acid dyes in boiling water, dilute to 50°C, dose into vessel over 15 min
process_steps.salt_addition: Glauber's salt (10 g/L) added as retarding agent to slow initial dye strike
process_steps.washing: Drain dye bath at 70°C -> Cold rinse for 10 min
process_steps.soaping: Apply Syntan After-fixing agent (3% owf) at 70°C for 20 min at pH 4.5
process_steps.neutralization: Rinse in cold water; target fabric core pH 5.5
process_steps.drying: Stenter dryer at 130°C under low tension to protect Spandex elasticity
process_steps.finishing: Apply Fluorocarbon Water-repellent finish or Hydrophilic softener

quality_parameters.rub_fastness: Dry Rubbing: Grade 4-5 | Wet Rubbing: Grade 4
quality_parameters.uniformity: Zero barre or streakiness across warp knit loops

defects.common_defects: Barre Streakiness, Low Wet Fastness without Fixer, Elastane Degradation
defects.causes: Rapid heating > 70°C, omission of Syntan fixer, excessive temp > 105°C on Spandex
defects.corrective_actions: Use leveling agent at 98°C for 30 min migration hold; re-apply Syntan fixing agent

safety.hazardous_chemicals: Glacial Acetic Acid, Syntan Fixing Agent (skin sensitizer)
safety.safety_precautions: Avoid inhalation of acid vapors; maintain local exhaust ventilation

references.source: Polyamide Wet Processing & Fastness Optimization Manual
references.notes: Maintain strict pH monitoring as acid dye uptake increases exponentially below pH 5.0

basic_information.recipe_name: Two-Bath HTHP Disperse & Reactive Dyeing of P/C 65/35 Blends

dye_information.dye_type: Disperse Dye (PES component) + Bifunctional Reactive Dye (Cotton component)
dye_information.dye_name: Disperse Yellow 54 + Disperse Blue 60 (Step 1) | Reactive Yellow 84 + Reactive Blue 21 (Step 2)

chemical_information.chemical_function: Protects disperse dyes and maintains pH 4.5 at 130°C
chemical_information.addition_sequence: Added in initial PES dyeing bath at 50°C

chemical_information.chemical_function: Removes disperse dye stained on cotton fibers before reactive dyeing
chemical_information.addition_sequence: Intermediate Reduction Clearing bath at 80°C for 20 min

chemical_information.chemical_function: Exhaustion electrolyte and alkali fixation for reactive dye on cotton component

process_parameters.temperature_profile: Stage 1 (PES): 60°C -> 130°C @ 1.5°C/min (hold 45m) -> Cool 80°C -> RC @ 80°C -> Stage 2 (Cotton): 60°C Salt/Alkali hold 60m -> Soap @ 95°C
process_parameters.time: Total Duration: 360 minutes (6.0 hours total cycle)
process_parameters.ph: Stage 1 pH: 4.5 - 5.0 | RC pH: 11.5 | Stage 2 pH: 10.8 - 11.2
process_parameters.pressure: Stage 1: 3.0 bar at 130°C | Stage 2: 1.0 bar Atmospheric

process_steps.pretreatment: Singeing, desizing, scouring, and Mercerizing (mercerization enhances cotton absorbency)
process_steps.dye_addition: Dose Disperse dye at 50°C (Stage 1); Dose Reactive dye at 50°C (Stage 2 after RC)
process_steps.salt_addition: Dose 50 g/L Glauber's salt in Stage 2 before alkali addition
process_steps.alkali_addition: Dose 15 g/L Soda Ash exponentially over 30 min at 60°C in Stage 2
process_steps.washing: Intermediate hot wash after RC; final cold wash after reactive fixation
process_steps.soaping: Primary soaping at 95°C for 15 min to remove unfixed reactive dye
process_steps.neutralization: Acid neutralize with Acetic Acid (1.0 g/L) at 50°C
process_steps.drying: Continuous cylinder dryer followed by Stenter frame at 150°C
process_steps.finishing: Apply Durable Press Resin Finish or Softener

quality_parameters.rub_fastness: Dry Rubbing: Grade 4-5 | Wet Rubbing: Grade 3-4
quality_parameters.uniformity: Perfect solid shade matching between polyester and cotton components

defects.common_defects: Cross-staining / Cross-shade mismatch between PES and Cotton, Low Rub Fastness
defects.causes: Incomplete reduction clearing of disperse dye off cotton; incorrect dye ratio
defects.corrective_actions: Ensure thorough RC at 80°C; recalibrate lab match prediction for individual fiber components

safety.ppe_required: Chemical aprons, face shields, heavy rubber boots, thermal gloves
safety.hazardous_chemicals: Caustic Soda, Sodium Hydrosulfite, Acetic Acid, Soda Ash
safety.safety_precautions: High thermal safety precautions during 130°C pressure drain phases

references.notes: Mercerization of cotton component prior to dyeing improves color yield by 20-30%

basic_information.recipe_name: Continuous Pad-Steam Vat Dyeing of 100% Cotton Woven Bottoms

dye_information.dye_name: Vat Olive Green (10 g/L) + Vat Brown 1 (5 g/L) + Vat Yellow 2 (3 g/L)

chemical_information.chemical_function: Chemical Reduction Pad liquor; converts insoluble vat pigment to soluble leuco form inside steamer
chemical_information.addition_sequence: Prepared in chemical padder trough continuously metered
chemical_information.compatibility: Must be maintained under strict reducing conditions

chemical_information.chemical_function: Prevents vat dye pigment migration during intermediate drying phase
chemical_information.addition_sequence: Added directly to dye pigment pad liquor

chemical_information.chemical_function: Oxidation bath; re-oxidizes soluble leuco vat dye back to insoluble pigment inside fiber
chemical_information.addition_sequence: Dosed in 1st wash box after steaming at 60°C

process_parameters.temperature_profile: Pad Pigment @ 25°C -> IR Pre-dry -> Hot Air Dry @ 110°C -> Chemical Pad @ 25°C -> Steamer @ 102°C (45s) -> Oxidation @ 60°C -> Soap @ 95°C
process_parameters.time: Fabric Speed: 40 m/min | Steamer Dwell Time: 45 seconds
process_parameters.ph: Reduction Steaming pH: 13.0 | Oxidation pH: 4.5 - 5.5 | Final Wash pH: 6.5
process_parameters.pressure: Pad Mangle Nip Pressure: 3.5 bar | Steamer Pressure: Atmospheric (Positively sealed)

process_steps.pretreatment: Singed, enzymatic desized, continuous bleached & mercerized woven canvas
process_steps.dye_addition: Pad dye pigment liquor at 65% wet pick-up $\rightarrow$ Pass through IR pre-dryer
process_steps.salt_addition: Glauber's salt (20 g/L) added to chemical reduction pad bath to suppress dye stripping
process_steps.alkali_addition: Caustic Soda (45 mL/L) continuously fed to chemical pad trough
process_steps.washing: Cold water overflow rinse immediately exiting steamer
process_steps.soaping: Oxidize with H2O2 at 60°C $\rightarrow$ Hot soaping at 95°C in continuous 4-chamber washer
process_steps.neutralization: Final wash box neutralization with Acetic Acid
process_steps.drying: Continuous steam can dryer stack (24 cylinders @ 3.0 bar steam)
process_steps.finishing: Apply Water-repellent / Sanforized anti-shrinkage mechanical finishing

quality_parameters.rub_fastness: Dry Rubbing: Grade 4-5 | Wet Rubbing: Grade 4
quality_parameters.light_fastness: Grade 7-8 (Maximum light fastness for military spec)
quality_parameters.uniformity: Zero center-to-selvedge or head-to-tail shade variation

defects.common_defects: Tailing (Shade lighter at end of roll), Side-to-Center Shade Variation, Oxidation Specks
defects.causes: High pad trough volume (>25L), non-uniform pad mangle crown nip pressure, oxygen ingress in steamer
defects.corrective_actions: Install trough displacement wedge (renewal time <30s); adjust swimming roller pneumatic profile; seal steamer water locks

safety.ppe_required: Full face shield, heavy butyl rubber aprons, chemical resistant boots, respirator
safety.hazardous_chemicals: Concentrated Caustic Soda 38°Bé, Sodium Hydrosulfite, Hydrogen Peroxide 35%
safety.safety_precautions: Continuous toxic gas monitoring for sulfur dioxide (SO2) near steamer exit

references.notes: Vat dyes provide unmatched chlorine bleach fastness and weathering resistance
